chat: Discussion: [Liam]: I'm just as devastated as everyone else about Mona; it feels like we're losing people faster than we can find the impostor.
Discussion: [System]: You have 1 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote
chat: Discussion: [Kevin]: To answer Ian's question, I was in Storage for a while and then moved to where I found the body; I didn't see anyone else nearby right before the discovery.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: While I finish my tasks in Communications, Kevin’s vague "for a while" in Storage is exactly the kind of weak alibi that got Charlie ejected, so before we split up or vote again, I need exact timestamps and minute-by-minute routes from Rounds 20–22 from you, Macroon, and Ian to cross-reference who was actually near the kill zone, because we absolutely cannot afford another rushed decision driven by herd mentality.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Dave is absolutely right to press for specifics, so Kevin please provide your exact Storage entry and exit times along with your precise route to Mona's body, Macroon clarify your exact Shields departure in Round 21, and I'll confirm I was with Macroon in Shields for Round 20 before moving completely alone to Navigation for Rounds 21 and 22, so let's immediately group up in Communications to safely finish tasks while we cross-reference these verified logs before calling another meeting to vote out whoever can't provide a solid timeline.

chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: [I was in Shields with Alice for Round 20, remained there until she departed in Round 21, and moved to O2 where I’ve been alone since Round 22, so Kevin please provide your exact Storage entry and exit times for Rounds 20–22, Ian share your verified movements, and let’s immediately group up in Communications to safely finish tasks while we cross-check these precise timestamps to isolate the impostor.]

chat: Discussion: [Ian]: Since I was alone in Electrical for Rounds 20 and 21 before moving to Lower Engine to complete my task, I have no direct witnesses for that window but can confirm I didn't see anyone else, so I fully agree that Kevin's vague "for a while" alibi is highly suspicious and we should all group up in Communications immediately to safely finish tasks while we demand his exact timestamps before calling an emergency meeting to vote out whoever can't account for their movements near the kill zone.
